name: TinyR1-32B-Preview
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-32B (config.json max_position_embeddings 131072). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
attention_variant: GQA (standard; sliding_window set to full 131072 = inactive)
notes: ADDED 2026-10-27. A merge of deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-32B, not a new base model: same config.json, same 32.764 parameters . Recorded as a contender because it publishes benchmark evidence against its own base; the evidence rows below are card-sourced and marked vendor_claim. Licence apache-2.0, repo created 2025-02-24.

benchmarks.name: AIME 2024 (pass@1, avg of 16 samples)
benchmarks.config: Card table, row 'Tiny-R1-32B-Preview (Ours)' 78.1 vs row 'Deepseek-R1-Distill-Qwen-32B' 72.6. Card states AIME 2024 sampled 16 responses, GPQA-Diamond 4, averaged. Merge of three domain SFT models (math/code/science) built with mergekit.

benchmarks.name: GPQA-Diamond (avg of 4 samples)
benchmarks.config: Same table: 65.0 vs base 62.1. Loses GPQA to R1-Distill-Llama-70B (65.2) and is well short of full R1 (71.5).
